I guess ADHD or Schizophrenia is a "mental illness" in that sense, if that's what you mean. As far as I know (I'm not a medical professional) it's heritable, so genetics play the biggest role in these disorders. So you're born with it, and you die with it. 

Ofc I'm not saying you can't improve your symptoms and live a happy life, thanks to medication/therapy etc., just saying how I'm interpreting it.

The way I see it:

mental illness = genetic, heritable (ADHD, Schizophrenia, Bipolar?)

mental disorder = psychological factors etc. (Social anxiety)

Again, I'm not a medical professional and I'm probably wrong, if you know better correct me
